riddles.question: True or false: do bulls charge at the color red?
options: No: bulls are red-green colorblind and react to movement
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: The cape's color does not matter.
riddles.explanation: Bulls react to the moving cape, not its color.

riddles.question: True or false: do goldfish really have a three-second memory?
options: No: they can remember for months
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Their memory beats the myth.
riddles.explanation: Goldfish learn routines and remember them for months.

riddles.question: True or false: is there no gravity in space?
options: There is microgravity everywhere astronauts go
No gravity at all beyond the Moon
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Think about what keeps the station circling.
riddles.explanation: Orbiting stations are in free fall; gravity is only slightly weaker.

riddles.question: True or false: does shaving make hair grow back thicker?
options: No: it feels coarser but grows the same
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: The tip changes, not the follicle.
riddles.explanation: Shaving blunts the tip; thickness and growth stay the same.

riddles.question: True or false: do we swallow eight spiders a year in our sleep?
options: No: that is an urban legend
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Spiders avoid sleeping giants.
riddles.explanation: The spider statistic was invented to show how myths spread.

riddles.question: True or false: does sugar make children hyperactive?
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: The excitement was doing the work.
riddles.explanation: Controlled studies show no hyperactivity link to sugar.

riddles.question: True or false: does lightning never strike the same place twice?
options: It can and does strike the same spot repeatedly
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Ask the tall buildings.
riddles.explanation: Lightning strikes the same tall structures many times a year.

riddles.question: True or false: is the great wall of china visible from the moon with the naked eye?
options: No: it is not visible from the Moon
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Astronauts confirm it.
riddles.explanation: Astronauts confirm the Wall is not visible from the Moon unaided.

riddles.question: True or false: do carrots improve your night vision?
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: The vitamin A helps, but no magic.
riddles.explanation: Carrots are healthy but do not give superhuman night vision.

riddles.question: True or false: do we use only ten percent of our brains?
options: No: we use virtually all of it
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Scans show the whole brain at work.
riddles.explanation: Brain imaging shows activity across virtually the entire brain.

riddles.question: True or false: did einstein fail math at school?
options: No: he excelled at math as a child
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Check his actual school records.
riddles.explanation: Einstein mastered calculus early; the failure story is a myth.

riddles.question: True or false: do hair and fingernails keep growing after death?
options: No: the skin retracts, exposing more
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: It is an illusion of shrinking skin.
riddles.explanation: Dehydrated skin pulls back, making hair and nails look longer.

riddles.question: True or false: do ostriches bury their heads in the sand?
options: No: they lie low or run from danger
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Check a farm documentary.
riddles.explanation: Ostriches never bury their heads; they flee or lie flat.

riddles.question: True or false: do dogs sweat through their tongues?
options: No: they pant and sweat through paw pads
They do not cool at all
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Panting is cooling by breath, not sweat.
riddles.explanation: Dogs mainly cool by panting and sweat minimally through paws.

riddles.question: True or false: is tomato a vegetable botanically?
options: No: botanically it is a fruit
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Think seeds.
riddles.explanation: Botanically a tomato is a fruit; cooking treats it as a vegetable.

riddles.question: True or false: does cracking your knuckles cause arthritis?
options: No: studies find no arthritis link
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: The pop is gas bubbles, not damage.
riddles.explanation: Knuckle cracking has not been linked to arthritis in studies.

riddles.question: True or false: do chameleons change color mainly for camouflage?
options: No: they mostly change for mood and temperature
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Communication comes first.
riddles.explanation: Chameleons shift color mostly to regulate heat and signal mood.

riddles.question: True or false: is mount everest the tallest mountain measured from base to peak?
options: No: Mauna Kea is taller from its base
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: One giant starts deep underwater.
riddles.explanation: Mauna Kea is taller base-to-peak; Everest is highest above sea level.

riddles.question: True or false: do houseflies live only 24 hours?
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Your kitchen flies disagree.
riddles.explanation: Houseflies typically live two to four weeks.

riddles.question: True or false: does the five-second rule make dropped food safe?
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Contact is instant.
riddles.explanation: Bacteria transfer to dropped food immediately; the rule is a myth.

riddles.question: True or false: is vitamin c a proven cold cure?
options: No: it may shorten colds slightly at most
riddles.subject: Common-Sense Traps
riddles.hint: Studies are unimpressive.
riddles.explanation: Research shows vitamin C does not cure colds.
